title: Private Banks
definition: Private sector banks are banking financial institutions where the majority stake (more than 50%) is held by private shareholders and individuals rather than the government, operating under the regulatory purview of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) via the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial microtopic for UPSC CSE Prelims (RBI guidelines, capital adequacy, differential banking, prompt corrective action) and Mains GS Paper III (financial inclusion, NPAs, consolidation of banking sector, and role of private capital in economic growth).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Private Banks.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Role of Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
Basics of Monetary Policy and Basel Norms
